name: Searchable Media Memory
description: Turn Shock's Art media into searchable memory while preserving the separate native-YouTube-Ask Clips editorial pipeline.
goal: Find -> Judge -> Pull -> Edit: semantic search returns useful named, spoken, visual, and silent footage with inspectable provenance; production Clips are derived only from YouTube native Ask.

executionLegend.codex: Requires workstation-local execution, GPU, browser/account state, or destructive data operations via fixed host profiles.
executionLegend.both: Repository work plus definitive host validation.

knowns.title: Architecture
knowns.detail: Searchable Media Memory is Media -> Traces -> Associations -> Entities; creator workflow is Find -> Judge -> Pull -> Edit.

knowns.title: Scoring isolation
knowns.detail: Filename, path, and filename-derived title must never influence semantic retrieval scores.

knowns.title: Local-first inference
knowns.detail: Bulk indexing/query inference stays on the workstation; FastAPI must not own the GPU runtime.

knowns.title: Archive direction
knowns.detail: Private YouTube is the intended archive/source layer; source media should be materialized temporarily rather than permanently mirrored.

knowns.title: Clips is separate
knowns.detail: Production Clips is an editorial pipeline distinct from Library semantic retrieval and has separate scoring/provenance.

knowns.title: Clips source policy proven
knowns.detail: Production Clips may interact with Gemini only through the YouTube page native Ask UI. Exact-main live smoke on pDC14ymQqWY produced 3 native-Ask candidates while direct-Gemini runs stayed 4 -> 4.

knowns.title: Existing language corpus
knowns.detail: Stored YouTube JSON3 transcripts have already produced 46,282 timestamped Language Traces across 41 archived streams.

knowns.title: Whisper corpus source clarified
knowns.detail: Repaired native-Ask clip windows plus timestamped captions are the candidate creator-speech benchmark corpus; benchmark ground truth still requires human-checked exact reference text.

knowns.title: Current vector baseline
knowns.detail: Persistent Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B 2048-d embeddings and SQLite cosine retrieval are proven on the provisional corpus; raw vector retrieval is sub-100ms at current scale.

knowns.title: Current derived data is provisional
knowns.detail: The existing local/Library/Clips derived state predates the corrected architecture and is scheduled for explicit user-approved reinitialization after this backlog reconciliation.

knowns.title: Interactive Qwen query runtime proven
knowns.detail: Exact deployed production main 14f9fe9787d44b6fb9e40d0f12c7c60ef01bdab6 wires Library semantic queries to the persistent isolated Qwen worker. Final live receipt retrieval-quality-production-warm-14f9fe97 measured five-query embedding at 560.7651 ms and total retrieval at 15679.9248 ms with model identity, rankings/scores, and metadata isolation unchanged; the earlier cold-to-warm proof on 8186f45d measured 279987.1706 -> 704.2648 ms.

unknowns.title: Whisper configuration
unknowns.detail: Best local model/precision for Nate's speech and unusual project names remains unmeasured.

unknowns.title: Association threshold
unknowns.detail: Same-object/related similarity threshold must be calibrated from labeled examples.

unknowns.title: Private YouTube retrieval
unknowns.detail: Authenticated private-source throughput and range reliability remain unproven.

unknowns.title: Long-duration lifecycle
unknowns.detail: A bounded restart/recovery/contention soak still needs a valid PASS.

unknowns.title: Long-form visual sampling
unknowns.detail: Adaptive sampling is encoded but representative long-form near-duplicate behavior remains to be validated when suitable footage is available.

items.title: Persist generic Media records
acceptance: Media records support stable local and remote identity plus core metadata.

items.title: Implement idempotent local media ingestion
acceptance: Repeat scans reuse unchanged and checksum-duplicate content.

items.title: Expose real Library catalog and ingest action
acceptance: Library renders persisted Media and exposes bounded ingest controls.

items.title: Standardize JARVIS lifecycle and health foundation
acceptance: Standard lifecycle/update/health contract is operational.

items.title: Add ingestion diagnostics and machine-readable Media inventory
acceptance: Inventory and ingest failures are machine-readable and attributable.

items.title: Load available validation corpus
acceptance: Available validation media is represented without modifying source files.

items.title: Validate corpus metadata, idempotence, and representative file costs
acceptance: Metadata is credible, repeat ingest is idempotent, and representative probe/hash costs are recorded.

items.title: Add Trace schema for timestamped extracted evidence
acceptance: Trace records evidence type, time range, provenance, extractor identity, confidence, and artifacts/text.

items.title: Add Embedding and IndexRun schemas
acceptance: Embedding generations and indexing runs are explicit and restart-safe.

items.title: Add indexing CLI/service boundary with deterministic fake backend tests
acceptance: Indexing can run outside FastAPI and resume safely without GPU-dependent unit tests.

items.title: Implement still/video visual Trace extraction and generated thumbnail artifacts
acceptance: Still/video extraction produces reproducible inspectable visual Traces.

items.title: Benchmark sparse FFmpeg extraction on available representative media
acceptance: Extraction runtime, frame count, scratch use, idempotence, and failure behavior are measured on available media.

items.title: Tune and encode adaptive sampling policy
acceptance: Duration-aware sampling is bounded, configuration-driven, and covered by deterministic tests.

items.title: Implement lazy multimodal EmbeddingBackend abstraction
acceptance: Text/image embedding is lazy and FastAPI startup does not import the ML stack.

items.title: Audit workstation Python/NVIDIA/CUDA/VRAM runtime
acceptance: Workstation inference capabilities are recorded without destructive runtime changes.

items.title: Benchmark Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B on workstation
acceptance: Model load, throughput, VRAM, batch behavior, and practical dimensions are measured.

items.title: Pin and document validated Qwen indexing environment
acceptance: Validated runtime/model configuration is reproducible and isolated from the web app.

items.title: Generate and persist normalized visual Trace embeddings
acceptance: Visual embeddings are deterministic by generation and never silently mixed.

items.title: Implement SQLite brute-force cosine retrieval with timing
acceptance: Top-K vector retrieval is deterministic and its database/scoring latency is measurable.

items.title: Expose semantic visual search API and Library UI
acceptance: Results expose Media/timestamp/thumbnail/score/provenance without using display metadata in semantic scoring.

items.title: Run representative semantic-query evaluation with filename leakage disabled
acceptance: Representative positives and absent controls are evaluated independently of filenames/path/title.

items.title: Add localized dense refinement around strong coarse matches
acceptance: Strong coarse matches can be refined locally without dense-indexing entire videos.

items.title: Convert existing timestamped transcripts into Language Traces
acceptance: Existing JSON3 transcript timestamps/provenance are preserved in Language Traces.

items.title: Implement lazy local transcription backend interface
acceptance: Local transcription remains optional, lazy, and isolated from FastAPI startup.

items.title: Benchmark local Whisper/faster-whisper on creator speech
acceptance: Use repaired native-Ask clip windows plus their timestamped captions as the candidate creator-speech corpus; human-check exact reference text before scoring.
Measure runtime/RTF, VRAM, timestamp validity, word accuracy, and project/object-name recall across the fixed model matrix.
Select the cheapest configuration that is good enough.
evidence: The fixed whisper-benchmark host profile and manifest validator are implemented. The previous failure was a corpus/ground-truth setup gap, not missing benchmark machinery.
Native-Ask clip lineage is now repaired, so those clip windows plus captions are the source material for benchmark labeling rather than rebuilding a corpus from scratch.

items.title: Implement hybrid language retrieval and fallback transcription flow
acceptance: Existing transcripts are preferred; missing speech can be transcribed locally; search exposes language evidence/provenance.

items.title: Create temporal Associations between nearby language and visual Traces
acceptance: Temporal associations are configurable and preserve source/target provenance.

items.title: Create cross-media visual-similarity Association candidates
acceptance: Anchored visual evidence can request and persist cross-media nearest-neighbor candidates with model/score provenance.

items.title: Build labeled association evaluation set and calibrate similarity threshold
acceptance: Related/same-object and unrelated examples are labeled and threshold is chosen from observed distributions.

items.title: Enforce one-hop automatic propagation and reviewable association state
acceptance: Automatic propagation cannot recursively chain; association review states are explicit.

items.title: Add Entity and EntityAlias schema
acceptance: Canonical project/object/person/process/place/concept entities support aliases without a rigid required taxonomy.

items.title: Add admin entity/evidence review and correction tools
acceptance: Admin can create/correct entities, aliases, evidence, and association decisions.

items.title: Fuse exact entity, language, visual, and association evidence in search
acceptance: Search combines evidence without collapsing provenance into one opaque score.

items.title: Run Dragon Staff cross-modal proof
acceptance: Dragon Staff returns named/spoken moments, nearby visual evidence, and genuinely related silent footage.

items.title: Introduce MediaRetriever materialize/range/cleanup interface
acceptance: Indexer no longer assumes source bytes are permanently local.

items.title: Centralize shared YouTube retrieval primitives
acceptance: YouTube source/caption acquisition has one production command owner while Clips and Library keep distinct cache semantics.

items.title: Implement local and YouTube MediaRetriever adapters
acceptance: Local and YouTube Media are materialized through the shared retriever without permanent source mirroring.
Authentication-specific proof is owned by IDX-038; credentials remain outside Git.
evidence: app/indexing/media_retrieval.py implements LocalMediaRetriever, YtDlpMediaRetriever, and DefaultMediaRetriever; accessible YouTube materialization and cleanup have already been host-proven. Authenticated/private behavior remains the separate IDX-038 validation.

items.title: Validate authenticated private-YouTube retrieval and throughput
acceptance: Private media metadata and bytes can be accessed with workstation-owned authentication.
Measure bounded/range versus full retrieval on representative private sources and document fallback behavior.

items.title: Implement scratch leases and cleanup for temporary source material
acceptance: Successful and failed jobs clean temporary source bytes while persistent derived artifacts remain separate.

items.title: Add persistent indexing queue and singleton worker ownership
acceptance: GPU work runs outside FastAPI; queue state is resumable/retriable; stale worker ownership can be recovered.

items.title: Add Library indexing controls, progress, retry/cancel, and diagnostics
acceptance: Library exposes bounded queue controls and diagnostics without running inference in request handlers.

items.title: Complete bounded indexer restart/recovery/contention soak
acceptance: Indexer survives stop/start and stale lease/PID recovery in a bounded main-only soak.
Scratch remains cleaned and the web app stays responsive while index work is active.
Record achieved Trace volume and SQLite vector-retrieval latency separately from query-model startup.
evidence: 2026-08-26 soak: health 63/63 and scratch 0 bytes, but restart recovery exposed a PID/lease bug; fixes landed afterward.
A later main-only soak exceeded the fixed 1800-second profile budget and did not produce a valid acceptance PASS.
The observed 57.607s average / 134.42s max semantic search includes model startup and is moved to IDX-046 rather than being a soak acceptance decision.

items.title: Integrate semantic result moments with source pull/open/editing actions
acceptance: A semantic result can open surrounding footage or materialize useful source/range without exposing storage complexity.

items.title: Validate Find -> Judge -> Pull -> Edit on mobile and desktop
acceptance: A real user can retrieve, judge, and pull useful footage without knowing filename/date/source; mobile usage is practical.

items.title: Restore and guard production Clips native YouTube Ask workflow
acceptance: Clips Update and production Clips candidates use only YouTube's native Ask interaction.
Direct Gemini video-analysis production routes are disabled and historical non-Ask candidates are excluded from the production feed.
A main-only real-browser host smoke passes on exact deployed main without increasing the direct-Gemini run count.
evidence: PR #7 restored production Clips to native YouTube Ask only and hard-disabled legacy direct-Gemini production routes.
PR #8 added main-only clips-native-ask-smoke. Exact deployed main 6c805f923c591967a0adaaf39f15a7112a41e254 passed 190/190 repo tests.

Live host smoke on regression stream pDC14ymQqWY passed: 3 production native-Ask candidates, production feed verified, direct-Gemini run count unchanged 4 -> 4, and all legacy direct-analysis routes returned HTTP 410.

items.title: Eliminate interactive semantic-query cold-start latency
acceptance: Semantic text-query inference uses a persistent isolated runtime instead of loading Qwen for every request.
Interactive query latency is measured separately from SQLite retrieval and is practical for normal Library use.
FastAPI remains isolated from the GPU/ML stack.
evidence: PR #29 added the persistent isolated Qwen query runtime; PRs #31 and #32 hardened Windows file IPC and versioned resident-worker lifecycle; PR #33 wired the actual production /api/library/search/visual route to that persistent backend. Final deployed production main is 14f9fe9787d44b6fb9e40d0f12c7c60ef01bdab6.

Candidate faa1378966891847dba85633144984386f500581 passed 227/227; exact merged-main 14f9fe9787d44b6fb9e40d0f12c7c60ef01bdab6 passed 227/227. Deployment receipt qwen-production-query-runtime-deploy-14f9fe97 completed as updated_exact with State.host_revision matching the exact SHA.

Cold-completion receipt retrieval-quality-protocol-second-8186f45d measured queryEmbeddingMs 279987.1706 and elapsedMs 421174.5755; immediate warm receipt retrieval-quality-protocol-warm-8186f45d measured queryEmbeddingMs 704.2648 and elapsedMs 14913.5918, about a 398x embedding speedup.

Final exact-deployed production-wiring receipt retrieval-quality-production-warm-14f9fe97 measured queryEmbeddingMs 560.7651 and elapsedMs 15679.9248. It used the same Qwen model generation and identical five-query rankings/scores; filename, title, and source path remained excluded from semantic scoring.

items.title: Reinitialize derived prototype data from canonical sources
acceptance: Only derived/prototype data is cleared; source/archive media and credentials are preserved.
Rebuild begins from canonical YouTube/local sources under the corrected architecture.
Old direct-Gemini candidate lineage is retained only if explicitly preserved for diagnostic provenance; production-derived state is rebuilt cleanly.
This item requires explicit user go-ahead before destructive host execution.
